meta.title: Leonardo Moyano | AI-First Software Engineer · React & TypeScript
meta.description: Leonardo Moyano, AI-First Software Engineer. Frontend and fullstack with React and TypeScript, design systems, and agentic workflows with Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode.

hero.subtitle: AI-First Software Engineer. I build frontend and fullstack products with React and TypeScript, create design systems, and design agentic workflows with Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode to ship faster without trading away quality.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: How I work, what I specialize in, and what I prioritize when building software.
about.p1: I'm a Software Engineer with over 5 years of frontend and fullstack experience, building web applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript. I've worked at startups and established companies, with distributed teams across LATAM and the United States, and helped create and evolve design systems adopted by multiple teams.
about.p2: I work AI-first: I use agents like Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode every day, and I invest in context engineering, giving them the right context, rules and tools so the output can be trusted. I also build agentic workflows (skills and commands) that speed up PR reviews, releases and changelogs.
about.p3: Speed doesn't replace judgment: I review what agents produce, cover the code with tests and keep dependencies secure, favoring simple solutions that are easy to maintain.
